description: Put dinner ahead of the shop, and fixed half past six as the table.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Walked ahead in the string of nine.
name: Hamnet Shakespeare

description: Warned that Judith had the vicar's voice ready, and counted the nine.
name: Joan Shakespeare

description: Walked ahead with the sermon stored.
name: Judith Shakespeare

description: Named the south-west wind, and told Quiney to let your hand go.
name: Mary Shakespeare

description: Asked for the town, and took Tuesday at the house when the shop was refused.
name: Richard Quiney

description: Kept watch on the children ahead down Old Town.
name: Richard Shakespeare

description: Gave the three heads of the sermon in order.
name: Susanna Shakespeare

description: Heard the ask, and did not grant the shop.
name: William Shakespeare
